title: Delivery Fee Credit on Early-Failing Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Delivery Fee Credit on Early-Failing Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment

**Terms.** A self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit that failed early is credited, on its refund, the delivery fee charged on its sale line:

- a unit with a **manufacturer-warranty repair** on its record that was **shipped for a virtual setup** is credited the **whole delivery fee**;
- a unit with such a repair that was handed over **any other way** is credited **half (50 percent)** of the delivery fee, rounded half up to the cent;
- any other unit is credited nothing.

The credit is added to the refund. For a self-pay refund this policy governs, and only for such a refund, the delivery fee, otherwise non-refundable, comes back to the patient only through this credit.

**Where the facts are read.** A manufacturer-warranty repair is a repair job in the device's service history whose cost was borne under the manufacturer warranty. The hand-over is the delivery mode on the delivery in that history (the latest delivery, where there is more than one). The delivery fee is the fee charged on the sale line in the device's billing history.

## Combinations

| Manufacturer-warranty repair on the record | Hand-over | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | virtual setup (shipped) | the whole delivery fee |
| yes | in-home, branch or courier | half the delivery fee |
| no | any | nothing |

**Worked credits (hypothetical sale lines).** Delivery fee 49.00, warranty repair, branch setup: 24.50. Delivery fee 19.95, warranty repair, courier: 9.975, rounded half up to 9.98. Delivery fee 79.00, warranty repair, virtual setup: 79.00.
